paragraphs: Mentioned in Eruvin 62a: the synagogue of the household of Agovar, in Rava's time. In Taanit 26a, Rav Papa came to the synagogue of Avi Gover; Hyman reports that Rashi explains this as a person's name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Agovar and Avi Gover are the supplied alternative forms. Bei denotes the household, not an extra personal name.

The positively matched synagogue passage in the consulted Eruvin text is 61b:8 and names Mar Yehudah; Hyman supplies 62a and Rava’s time. The consulted Taanit 26a paragraph names Rav Pappa and Avi Gover, while its Rashi comment allows a person’s name OR a place name. Hyman reports only a person’s name. His narrower report and supplied locator remain visible beside these differences; no personal identity is inferred.
